x: Wise, who jumped 5ft. 4in. for the seniors, won at 5ft. 1in., Savage cleared 4ft. 11in., and Leigh 4ft. 10in. All are keen and with training should greatly improve.

Amongst these are Wise, Adey, Savage and Leigh, who are definitely interested in high jumping, an event for which in the past we have had no exponents, but with these recruits it is hoped that the Club will soon take its rightful place amongst high jumpers.

Dick Negus and Boxall of the Juniors and Leigh have possibilities, but need to do a lot of study of technique to show their best. The Hop, Step and Jump, rather a neglected event heretofore, we have tried to popularise by including the event in matches.

Peter Whewell had his first race in our colours finishing 4th behind Ibbottson, Leigh and Ravald and Bill Dance took us up a further place. Geoff North got us to within 8 seconds of Manchester D.L.C. but Gerry, in his first outing after his calf injury, could do nothing to stop the two leading clubs…
